protocol.arithmetic: IEEE754 binary64, JS statement and operator evaluation order, explicit intermediate rounding, no fused multiply-add
protocol.motion: xorshift32 nonzero state, left13 unsigned-right17 left5 with uint32 truncation, state/2^32, branch draw order
protocol.private_samples: independent uniform 53-bit CSPRNG samples, one persisted public encounter plan; private terminal treasure reward stored once
protocol.integer: canonical decimal unsigned128; safe integer identifiers, day and tick; bounded integral per-action economic amounts
protocol.hash: little-endian float64: clockMinutes,bitePreparationRemaining,waitRemaining,barY,barVelocity,progress,elapsed,hitTime,effectiveTime,currentMissTime,longestMissTime,fish position,y,speed,target,drift,reverseRemaining,dartDirection,treasure y,progress; little-endian uint64: day,tick,motion state,draw_count,phase(1 waiting 2 playing 3 success 4 failed),flags(wasHit1 held2 paused4 fish8 treasure16 secured32 perfect64); missing fish/treasure floats zero
protocol.persistence: all cast floating fields are f64: plus exact little-endian 8-byte lowercase hexadecimal; profile clock persisted as f64 bits
